facts.text: The hotel is on West Beijing Road in the heart of Jing'an District, Shanghai's cultural and business center.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan is situated on West Beijing Road in the heart of Jingan District, Shanghai’s cultural and business center.

facts.text: The interiors blend traditional English and Chinese palatial styles with elements of Chinese art such as calligraphy and handcrafted gold foil paintings.
facts.excerpt: blending traditional English and Chinese palatial styles with elements of Chinese art and culture, such as calligraphy and handcrafted gold foil paintings

facts.text: The hotel's public spaces showcase five glass sculptures by artist Dale Chihuly.
facts.excerpt: public spaces showcase five glass sculptures by world-renowned artist Dale Chihuly

facts.text: The Astor Ballroom includes a 90-square-meter LED wall projection system.
facts.excerpt: Its 1,400-square-meter Astor Ballroom includes a 90-square-meter LED wall projection system

facts.text: The Manor, the executive lounge, is on the 55th floor with panoramic views over Jing'an District and downtown Shanghai.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 55th floor, offering panoramic views of the core landscape of Jing'an District and a breathtaking view of Shanghai downtown.

facts.text: The St. Regis Bar pays homage to the King Cole Bar and serves premium whiskeys, fine wines, rare spirits, champagnes and handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Paying homage to the world-renowned King Cole Bar, The St. Regis Bar is an elegant place to enjoy premium whiskeys, fine wines, rare spirits, champagnes and handcrafted cocktails.

facts.text: The Drawing Room in the lobby serves a modern interpretation of Afternoon Tea every afternoon, celebrating Caroline Astor's legacy.
facts.excerpt: Every afternoon, get pampered with our modern interpretation of Afternoon Tea, celebrating Caroline Astor's legacy from the early 1900s.

facts.text: Bespoke is a steakhouse with a view of West Beijing Road, serving premium steaks and fine wines.
facts.excerpt: With a breathtaking view of West Beijing Road, Bespoke is the ideal choice for both dining and social events in Jing'an, Shanghai. Enjoy premium steaks and fine wines

facts.text: Seki-tei is a Japanese restaurant with four private rooms.
facts.excerpt: With 4 private rooms, the gastronomy experience at this Japanese restaurant in Jing'an promotes authentic flavors

facts.text: Yan Ting is the hotel's Chinese restaurant, with contemporary and classic Chinese decor.
facts.excerpt: Yan Ting provides a singular dining experience in Jing'an, Shanghai beginning with its contemporary and classic Chinese décor.

facts.text: The St. Regis Patisserie offers freshly baked breads, desserts, handmade chocolates and customized cakes made by the hotel's Western pastry team.
facts.excerpt: It offers a variety of freshly baked breads, desserts, handmade chocolates, customized cakes, as well as freshly ground coffee and select teas, all prepared by the hotel's professional Western pastry team.

facts.text: The St. Regis Spa and Fitness Center offer specialty massages, a 24-hour fitness center, a sauna, a steam room and a yoga room.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Spa and Fitness Center offer specialty massages and other indulgent treatments, as well as a 24-hour fitness center, a sauna, a steam room and a yoga room.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool with a lifeguard on duty.
facts.excerpt:
Lifeguard on Duty

Pool Heated

facts.text: The Premier Deluxe room is a corner room with a city view and an oversized bathroom.
facts.excerpt: Premier Deluxe room - 56sqm, City View, Corner room, Oversized bathroom, Available in king size bed

facts.text: The St. Regis Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a guest powder room.
facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Suite at our Jing'an Shanghai hotel is a one-bedroom suite with guest powder room

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan.

facts.excerpt:

facts.text: The closest airport is Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport, about 16.2 km away.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Shanghai Jingan is Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport (SHA). SHA is located approximately 16.2 KM from the hotel.
